summary_en: NHK Spring raised interim dividend to 40 yen per share from 33 yen and revised upward full-year dividend forecast to 84 yen per share from 69 yen, reflecting stronger-than-expected interim results and full-year guidance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Interim Dividend and Revision of Full-Year Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, NHK Spring announced increases to both interim and full-year dividend per share for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend was raised by 7 yen to 40 yen per share, up from the previous forecast of 33 yen, with an ex-date of September 30, 2026 and an effective date of December 2, 2026. The interim dividend total is 8,144 million yen. Concurrently, the company revised upward its full-year dividend forecast by 15 yen to 84 yen per share, comprising the interim payment of 40 yen and a revised final dividend of 44 yen, versus the prior forecast of 69 yen (33 yen interim and 36 yen final).

The company stated that it recognizes shareholder returns as a priority and bases its dividend decisions on consolidated earnings and payout ratio considered comprehensively, aiming for stable and sustained dividends. The increases reflect the improved interim results announced on the same date and the strengthened full-year consolidated earnings guidance.
